name: analytics-poc-guardrail
description: Demo guardrail for the portfolio Q&A assistant: blocks customer-level, credit-decision and advice requests, PII and prompt attacks.

topicsConfig.name: IndividualCustomerOrAccount
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for information about a specific identified customer, borrower or loan account, including their balances, status, contact details or identity documents.
examples: What is the outstanding for account AB12345678?
Show me the loan details of Ramesh Kumar
Which customers have defaulted this month?

topicsConfig.name: CreditDecisions
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to approve, reject, price or assess creditworthiness for a specific loan application or borrower.
examples: Should we approve this borrower's loan?
What interest rate should we give this customer?

topicsConfig.name: InvestmentOrFinancialAdvice
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for personal investment, trading or financial planning advice.
examples: Where should I invest my savings?

regexesConfig.name: LoanOrCustomerId
regexesConfig.description: Account/customer id format in this dataset

blockedInputMessaging: I can only help with portfolio-level KPI questions. This request was blocked by the safety guardrail.
blockedOutputsMessaging: The response was blocked by the safety guardrail.
